text: 部署复败，主顾震怒。
gloss: The deploy failed again and the client is furious.

text: 用户复函曰：此正吾所欲，感铭无已。
gloss: The user wrote back: this is exactly what I needed, thank you so much.

text: 例会自周二九时半改至九时三刻。
gloss: Daily standup moved from 9:30 to 9:45 on Tuesdays.

text: 恢复之卷尽失，三阅月之日志俱亡。
gloss: We lost the entire recovery volume. Three months of journal entries are gone.

text: 班机先至二十分，行囊首现于传送带。
gloss: The flight landed twenty minutes early and my bag was first on the belt.

text: 已删之文，接口依制返四〇四。
gloss: The API returns 404 for deleted documents by design.

text: 导师曰：君之设计稿乃本岁所见最明澈者。
gloss: My mentor said my design doc was the clearest she had read this year.

text: 演示崩于四十投资者之前，无人能复启之。
gloss: The demo crashed in front of forty investors and nobody could restart it.

text: 与故友啜咖啡，谈三时如弹指。
gloss: Coffee with an old friend; we talked for three hours and it felt like minutes.

text: 三月之发票已于二十八日偿付。
gloss: The invoice for March was paid on the 28th.

text: 登台前一小时，彼等以函取消吾之演讲。
gloss: They cancelled my talk an hour before I went on stage, by email.

text: 追竞态二日，构建复绿。
gloss: The build is green again after two days of chasing the race condition.

text: 会议纪要：议程一至四已议，下次会于周四。
gloss: Meeting notes: agenda items 1-4 covered; next sync Thursday.

text: 手机坠入港湾，旅中诸照尽没于水。
gloss: I dropped my phone in the harbour. Every photo of the trip is underwater.

text: 实习生今日首献其补丁，未经改而径过审。
gloss: The intern shipped her first patch today and it passed review untouched.
boundary: empty input

text: 季报载营收四百二十万，同比增八分。
gloss: The quarterly report lists revenue of 4.2M, up 8% year over year.

text: 吾弟手术顺遂，医云康复当速。
gloss: My brother's surgery went perfectly; the doctor said recovery will be fast.

text: 房东将售此宅，吾仅余两月搬迁。
gloss: The landlord is selling the flat. I have two months to move.

text: 日光穿牖，测试运行，一无所焚。
gloss: Sunlight through the window while the tests ran. Nothing was on fire.

text: Schema v12 增 retention_days 字段，默认三十。
gloss: Schema v12 adds the retention_days column, default 30.

text: 客户以诉讼相胁，复函中并抄送其律师。
gloss: The customer threatened legal action and CC'd their lawyer on the reply.

text: 得此瑕疵，一旗反置，修复仅二行。
gloss: Found the bug. One inverted flag. The fix is two lines.

text: 团队午膳之单：炒河粉三、绿咖喱一、炒饭一。
gloss: Team lunch order: three pad thai, one green curry, one fried rice.

text: 本周所书皆须重作，上游之规已改。
gloss: Everything I wrote this week has to be redone; the spec changed upstream.

text: 童稚今日植番茄于园中。
gloss: The children planted tomatoes in the garden today.

text: 备份于寅时三刻二分告成，四十一吉，无差报。
gloss: Backup completed at 03:12, 41 GB, no errors reported.

text: 人事确认裁员，全组周五前尽去。
gloss: HR confirmed the layoffs. My whole team is gone by Friday.

text: 资助获批，两年之资，无所附带。
gloss: The grant was approved. Two years of funding, no conditions.

text: 图书馆逾期还书，日取费二分半。
gloss: The library charges 0.25 per day for late returns.
